title: Polynomial calculus degree of Tseitin formulas is half the carving width
subject: The exact polynomial calculus degree of Tseitin formulas outside characteristic 2
conclusion: Over any field of characteristic other than 2, the polynomial calculus degree of the Tseitin system of a connected graph with an odd charge, written as balanced plus-minus-one binomials and measured modulo y^2 = 1, lies between ceil(cvw/2) and floor(cvw/2) + 1 for carving width cvw, exactly ceil(cvw/2) when cvw is odd. The standard encodings need the larger of the maximum degree and that value, plus at most one before reduction.
